name: Timeguard spends a charge only on a qualifying hit (#3390)
contract: Timeguard 804441: 'the next 3 instances of direct damage that deal more than 20% of their total health or reduce the target below 35% health to deal $s3% less damage'. Effect 0 is aura 69 SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB with EffectBasePoints 1 (die 1 => an absorb of two points), effects 1 and 2 are SPELL_AURA_DUMMY carrying EffectBasePoints 34 (die 1 => 35, the health threshold) and 49 (die 1 => 50, the reduction). With no script, the two-point shield is consumed by the first hit of any size and Unit::CalcAbsorbResist removes the whole aura, so the record's ProcCharges 3 budget never survives one hit. Injure Self 19806 is the probe: a single SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE of EffectBasePoints 69, die 1 => 70, implicit target 1 (caster), SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_NONE so Unit::IsSpellCrit returns 0 and it can never crit, no cooldown, no GCD category and no mana. At full health 70 damage is under a fifth of maximum health and leaves the Chronomancer far above 35%, so it must not touch the shield; at 400 health it leaves the target under 35% of a maximum of at least 1200, so it must spend exactly one of the three charges.

steps.label: 400 health is under 35% of maximum and survives a 70 damage hit
Timeguard lands on the ally target
Timeguard starts with the record's three charges
A small hit at full health leaves Timeguard up
A small hit at full health spends no charge
The Chronomancer is below the 35% threshold
The qualifying hit spends exactly one charge
The guarded Chronomancer survives the qualifying hit
